outcome: 10-year predicted risk of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD)
30-year predicted risk of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD)
cohort: The study included 4432 individuals enrolled during pregnancy, with a median age of 30.5 years and a median gestational age of 27.9 weeks at enrollment.
finding: Individuals who experienced hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP) or gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) had a significantly higher predicted 10- and 30-year risk of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) 10-14 years after delivery.
